query: Consider the following context: The recent trend of high-entropy alloys (HEAs) was studied extensively for their promising mechanical properties, but individual constituents' effects have remained unexplored. In that context, which method can be used for the effects of changing the percentage of elements of HfNbTaTiZr-HEA on the mechanical properties, and why?

generation.hypothesis: Changing the percentage of elements in HfNbTaTiZr-HEA will significantly impact its mechanical properties.
generation.intervention: Altering the percentage of elements (Hf, Nb, Ta, Ti, Zr) in the alloy
generation.mechanism: Solid solution strengthening and lattice strain effects
generation.predicted_outcome: Improvement or deterioration in mechanical properties such as strength, hardness, and ductility
generation.baseline: The initial composition and mechanical properties of HfNbTaTiZr-HEA
generation.boundary: The limits of solubility and phase stability in the HEA system
generation.uncertainty: The exact nature and extent of the effects due to the complexity of HEA systems and interactions among elements

falsification_experiment.design: Systematic variation of elemental percentages and measurement of resulting mechanical properties
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If no significant correlation is found between elemental composition changes and mechanical property variations, the hypothesis is falsified
